**Computed primary model:** Fixed f(x1,x2)=x1+10*x2² at(1,0), output1, gradient[1,0]. Set x1 to0: output0, absolute change1. **Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict which feature has zero initial gradient; recall moving x2 to−1 also increases output by10 despite the same initial zero derivative.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Compute gradient then Intervene x1/x2 recomputes actual predictions and differences; Change base point exposes local variation. Retain original gradient and both finite changes; no image blob pretending to establish explanation completeness.
